resources.name: FTC Robot Controller SDK
resources.description: The official Android Studio workspace for FTC robot programming. Includes the Robot Controller app, Driver Station app, sample OpModes, and the hardware and sensor APIs used by most FTC codebases.

resources.name: Road Runner
resources.description: A motion planning library for FTC that generates smooth paths and provides trajectory following, dead-wheel odometry, and tunable drive constraints.

resources.name: Pedro Pathing
resources.description: A path-following library focused on fast autonomous routines with localizers, parametric paths, and a visual path builder.

resources.name: FTCLib
resources.description: A community library that extends the FTC SDK with command-based programming, gamepad helpers, motor wrappers, and reusable subsystem utilities.

resources.name: FTC Dashboard
resources.description: A web-based telemetry and tuning dashboard for FTC. Inspect live robot data, tune control loops, and visualize field positions during development.

resources.name: Game Manual 0
resources.description: A community-written guide covering FTC hardware, CAD, programming, control systems, awards, and team operations. A strong first stop for new teams.

resources.name: FTC Wiring Guide
resources.description: A practical guide to FTC control system wiring, connector types, motor and servo connections, and common electrical pitfalls.

resources.name: OpenVault FTC Portfolio Archive
resources.description: A searchable archive of published FTC engineering portfolios organized by season. Each portfolio remains the work of the team that produced it.
resources.attribution: OpenVault, maintained by FTC Team 25710 Alpine Robotics

resources.name: BIOBUZZ FTC Field Model
resources.description: The official BIOBUZZ (2026-27) FTC field model in Onshape for reference geometry, robot sizing, and field-element planning.

resources.name: FTC Competition Manual
resources.description: The official competition manual for the current FTC season, including game rules, robot inspection requirements, and tournament procedures.
